abilities.name: synchronize
abilities.effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

abilities.name: magic-guard
abilities.effect: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

kanto.flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its IQ (intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.

original-johto.flavorText: It has an IQ of 5000. It calcu­ lates many things in order to gain the edge in every battle.

hoenn.flavorText: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an ALAKAZAM’s muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its highly developed brain is on par with a supercomputer. It can use all forms of psychic abilities.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.

original-unova.flavorText: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.

updated-unova.flavorText: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.

kalos.flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its IQ (intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Alakazam’s brain continually grows, infinitely multiplying brain cells. This amazing brain gives this Pokémon an astoundingly high IQ of 5,000. It has a thorough memory of everything that has occurred in the world.

original-alola.flavorText: Its brain cells continue to increase in number until its death. The older the Alakazam, the larger its head.

updated-alola.flavorText: If it trusts someone deeply, it will let them have one of its spoons. Anything you eat with that spoon is apparently delicious.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: A Pokémon that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns—that’s why this Pokémon is smart.

swsh.flavorText: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It’s said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

pla.flavorText: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.
